description: List SMS/MMS messages, optionally filtered by recipient, sender, and status, sorted by creation time (newest first).

to.description: Optional recipient phone number (in E.164 format) to filter messages by.

from_.description: Optional sender phone number (in E.164 format) to filter messages by.

status.description: Optional message status to filter by (e.g. queued, sent, delivered, undelivered, failed, received).

page_size.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a list of message objects plus paging fields (page, page_size, uri); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single message by its sid.

sid.description: The unique sid of the message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized message object; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create (send) a new outbound message from one phone number to another.

to.description: The recipient phone number in E.164 format.

from_.description: The sender phone number in E.164 format.

body.description: Optional text body of the message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created message object; on failure (missing To or From), output contains an error message.

description: List voice calls, optionally filtered by recipient, caller, and status, sorted by creation time (newest first).

to.description: Optional recipient phone number (in E.164 format) to filter calls by.

from_.description: Optional caller phone number (in E.164 format) to filter calls by.

status.description: Optional call status to filter by (e.g. queued, completed, no-answer, busy, in-progress).

page_size.description: Maximum number of calls to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a list of call objects plus paging fields (page, page_size, uri); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create (initiate) a new outbound voice call from one phone number to another.

to.description: The recipient phone number in E.164 format.

from_.description: The caller phone number in E.164 format.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created call object; on failure (missing To or From), output contains an error message.

description: List incoming (owned) phone numbers on the account, optionally filtered by a specific phone number.

phone_number.description: Optional phone number (in E.164 format) to filter the list by.

page_size.description: Maximum number of phone numbers to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a list of incoming phone number objects plus paging fields (page, page_size, uri); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Look up carrier/format information for a phone number, including country code, validity, and caller name if owned.

phone_number.description: The phone number to look up, ideally in E.164 format.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the lookup result object (phone_number, national_format, country_code, valid, caller_name, url); on failure, output contains an error message.
